findings.current: A temperature swing of sixty degrees in a single day.
findings.defect: The source emphasizes the striking size of the daily temperature difference (자그마치, “as much as/no less than”); the assembled line states the number neutrally. The accepted baseline preserved that emphasis.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes a temperature difference reaching as much as sixty degrees, with an explicit emphasis on its magnitude.
findings.replacement: A daily temperature swing of no less than sixty degrees.

findings.current: to save their fellow believers persecuted even in the Western world.
findings.defect: “Fellow believers” narrows 동포, which means compatriots or fellow countrymen; the source does not specify that these people are fellow believers.
findings.rationale: The source says 동포들, referring to their compatriots. The religious context does not establish the narrower affiliation added by “fellow believers.”
findings.replacement: to save their compatriots, persecuted even in the Western world.

summary: Two minor fidelity issues: an omitted emphasis on the temperature swing and a narrowed meaning for “compatriots.”
